_provenance: Project-owned vetted Workable company-slug list. A guessed slug from a company's public name is NOT reliable (confirmed live 2026-08-10: several guessed slugs 404'd or returned a permanently empty jobs array): each slug below was found from an actual live posting URL (apply.workable.com/<slug>/j/...) and verified against https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{slug}?details=true (HTTP 200 with a non-empty jobs array) on the verified_at date. Additions are code changes: verify the endpoint by hand against a real live posting URL, update verified_at, and review in a PR. This list is never fetched from a remote source at run time.
